walkthroughs.body_html:
Balloon: V = (4/3)πr^3, dV/dt = 12. Find dr/dt at r = 2.

dV/dt = 4πr^2 dr/dt, so 12 = 16π dr/dt, dr/dt = 3/(4π).

mcqs.q: Which average is best to use for the data set [2, 3, 3, 4, 4, 4, 5, 100]?
options: -15, because two negatives multiply to give a larger negative result.
The mean — it always gives the most accurate average.
The median (3.5) — it isn't distorted by the outlier 100, unlike the mean.
The mode, because the most common value is always the best representative.
